batch_source:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=juggle-smooth
#SBATCH --partition=allnodes
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=6
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00
#SBATCH --output=/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/runs/td3/noisy_history_smooth_20261031_seed0_slurm.log
set -euo pipefail
cd /scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/airhockey-mpl
export PYTHONPATH=/scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl
exec /scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/.venv/bin/python -u /scratch/cluster/mrudolph/documents/air-hockey-rl/runs/td3/noisy_history_smooth_20261031_seed0_orchestrate.py
initialization: random actor, critics and history encoder; no pretrained checkpoint
tests: online and target at 1M, 3M, 6M; 32 reused starts 700000-700031; 20k recording limit; descriptive raw metrics, no binary gates
